rules: Current face-space-normalization-research-v0 name is a research namespace, not calibrated normalization authority.

Governed reference-only center/scale research statistics may be frozen only from an explicit method decision and exact reference-split lineage; percentile boundaries, enum boundaries, Production thresholds, and normalization activation remain unauthorized.

Multi-subject coverage, general-face coverage, and reference-distribution readiness must come from a validated face-space-reference-corpus-summary-v0; caller-supplied booleans cannot satisfy those gates.

A structurally valid reference-corpus summary can establish corpus coverage readiness only. It does not authorize center/scale statistics, thresholds, normalization activation, or substitute for real-photo pose/expression stability.
Same-provider normalization readiness is independent from cross-provider anchor equivalence.
Cross-provider normalization must additionally respect providerAnchorEquivalence from the semantic contract.
Controlled 3D same-identity stress is diagnostic operator evidence only; Face Space photo normalization readiness requires real-photo same-subject pose and expression evidence.
A provisional normalization candidate remains research-only and must not activate Archetype, Face Space production, or style recommendation.
No identity embedding or biometric identity matching may be used to establish same-subject linkage; linkage must come from dataset provenance or manual research metadata.
Real-photo pose/expression readiness must be derived from validated real-photo stability reports; caller-supplied booleans or evidence-kind strings cannot satisfy the gate.
The readiness evaluator re-summarizes and validates the supplied real-photo report collection before using it.
Reference-corpus coverage readiness must be derived by validating a raw face-space-reference-corpus-v0 manifest inside the readiness evaluator.
Caller-supplied reference-corpus summary objects are forbidden as readiness inputs.

A structurally valid reference corpus cannot satisfy multi-subject, general-face, or reference-distribution readiness gates until a versioned adequacy review bound to the exact reference-split fingerprint is present.
Reference-corpus adequacy must not be inferred automatically from record count, and no numeric adequacy threshold is invented by this readiness contract.

A complete real-photo head_yaw/head_pitch/head_roll/expression report collection is structural evidence only; it cannot satisfy pose/expression readiness until an explicit adequacy review bound to the exact collection fingerprint is present.
Real-photo stability adequacy must not be inferred automatically from report count or nuisance-class coverage, and no numeric adequacy threshold is invented by this readiness contract.
An explicit real-photo hold_for_more_evidence decision must remain a readiness blocker even when nuisance-class coverage is structurally complete.

Historical single-fixture unresolved markers are superseded only when their exact requirement is replaced by governed reference-corpus or real-photo structural evidence; adequacy gates remain independent.

Supplemental real-photo evidence with unverified same-session provenance or research-use authorization may expand descriptive evidence but cannot by itself satisfy the provisional normalization-research adequacy gate.

counterfactualPreflight.purpose: Prove that the selected method and reference statistics can construct a same-provider provisional research candidate after a future legitimate real-photo adequacy promotion, without treating the hypothetical promotion as evidence.
